message: Triggering scans from the UI is not configured. Set: secret GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN (fine-grained token, repository permission "Actions: Read and write"): wrangler secret put GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN; var GITHUB_REPOSITORY = "owner/repo" in wrangler.toml [vars]. Optional vars: SCAN_WORKFLOW (default "scan.yml"), GITHUB_REF (default "main").
missing: secret GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN (fine-grained token, repository permission "Actions: Read and write"): wrangler secret put GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN
